prompt: Elena asked our neighbour where (he / to buy) his coffee beans.
explanation_ru: В косвенном специальном вопросе сохраняется прямой порядок слов без did, а Present Simple сдвигается в Past Simple (bought).

prompt: Rain started near the station, so Darius asked me ___ a spare umbrella.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос в косвенной речи вводится союзом if/whether с прямым порядком слов и без did. Частые ошибки — опустить if или оставить вопросительный порядок слов.

prompt: Ciara wondered where (my uncle / to live) with his dog.
explanation_ru: После wondered в косвенном вопросе используется прямой порядок слов (подлежащее + глагол), а Present Simple переходит в Past Simple (lived).

prompt: The cashier smiled and asked Jakub ___ a paper receipt.
explanation_ru: Для передачи общего вопроса нужен союз if или whether (а не that) и прямой порядок слов без вспомогательного глагола did.

prompt: My colleague asked me (I / to enjoy) working in the garden.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос присоединяется с помощью if или whether, порядок слов остаётся прямым, а глагол сдвигается в Past Simple (enjoyed).

prompt: A tourist asked me did I know the way to the pool.
answer: A tourist asked me if I knew the way to the pool.
accepted_answers: A tourist asked me if I knew the way to the pool.
A tourist asked me whether I knew the way to the pool.
explanation_ru: В косвенном общем вопросе нельзя сохранять вспомогательный глагол did и инверсию: нужно добавить if/whether и поставить глагол в Past Simple (knew).

prompt: We needed help moving sofas, so Mei asked me (my brother / to drive) a van.
explanation_ru: Косвенный общий вопрос требует союза if или whether, убирает does и сдвигает глагол drive в Past Simple (drove).

prompt: Our host showed us the flat, and Sofia asked where (the children / can / to play) safely.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе модальный глагол can переходит в could и стоит после подлежащего (the children could play), без инверсии.

prompt: Drivers usually took the highway. I didn't understand why (our neighbour / always / to avoid) the main road.
explanation_ru: После why сохраняется прямой порядок слов без does, а наречие always стоит перед глаголом в Past Simple (always avoided).

prompt: We wanted a group photo in the park, but Tariq wasn't sure ___ a built-in timer.
explanation_ru: После wasn't sure в прошедшем времени общий вопрос вводится союзом if/whether со сдвигом в Past Simple (had). Использование that или did — типичные ошибки.

prompt: More parents arrived for the concert, so the headteacher asked where the spare chairs were.
answer: More parents arrived for the concert, so the headteacher asked where the spare chairs were.
accepted_answers: More parents arrived for the concert, so the headteacher asked where the spare chairs were.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: после where использован прямой порядок слов (подлежащее the spare chairs перед глаголом were) и верный сдвиг времени в Past Simple.

prompt: Looking for the envelope, Hana asked Idris, “Where did you put the stamps?” → Hana asked Idris …
answer: Hana asked Idris where he had put the stamps.
accepted_answers: Hana asked Idris where he had put the stamps.
Hana asked Idris where he'd put the stamps.
explanation_ru: Специальный вопрос в Past Simple переводится в косвенную речь с прямым порядком слов без did, заменой you → he и сдвигом в Past Perfect (he had put).

prompt: Priya planned a Saturday dinner for the exchange students. Before shopping, she phoned the organiser to check a few details. First, she asked (the guests / to like) fish. She also wanted to know what time (everyone / will / to arrive) at her flat.
explanation_ru: Первый вопрос общий, поэтому нужны if/whether и Past Simple (liked); во втором после what time сохраняется прямой порядок слов и сдвиг will → would.

prompt: Gareth spotted a silver kettle on the bottom shelf. He wasn't sure about the features, so he called a shop assistant over. He asked (the kettle / to switch) itself off automatically. Then he wondered how much (the blue model / to cost).
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске общий вопрос вводится через if/whether с переходом в Past Simple (switched); во втором после wondered how much нужен прямой порядок слов и прошедшая форма cost.

prompt: I phoned the adult college about an evening Spanish class. The receptionist was very helpful on the line. I asked her when (the term / to begin) in autumn. I also asked (I / can / to borrow) the course book from the library, and she said yes.
explanation_ru: После when используется прямой порядок слов и Past Simple (began), а общий вопрос во втором пропуске требует if/whether и сдвига can → could.

prompt: Commuters complained outside the station after seeing the new timetable board, and a local reporter asked the director why (ticket prices / to increase) twice since January.
explanation_ru: Маркер since January указывает, что в прямой речи был Present Perfect, который в косвенном вопросе сдвигается в Past Perfect при прямом порядке слов (ticket prices had increased).

prompt: Stepping into the warm café while everyone else sat in T-shirts, Kavita laughed and asked Ronan why (he / to wear) two heavy coats.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о действии в момент разговора (Why are you wearing…?), поэтому в косвенном вопросе Present Continuous переходит в Past Continuous без инверсии (he was wearing).

prompt: Returning from the late train, Vera couldn't understand why was the front door unlocked when nobody else lived in the flat.
answer: Returning from the late train, Vera couldn't understand why the front door was unlocked when nobody else lived in the flat.
accepted_answers: Returning from the late train, Vera couldn't understand why the front door was unlocked when nobody else lived in the flat.
Returning from the late train, Vera could not understand why the front door was unlocked when nobody else lived in the flat.
explanation_ru: Во встроенном вопросе после couldn't understand why нельзя ставить глагол was перед подлежащим: нужен прямой порядок слов (why the front door was unlocked).

prompt: Nadia checked into a small guesthouse in York during a freezing gale. That evening, the landlady knocked and said, “Is your room warm enough, or shall I fetch another blanket?” Which report is correct?
options: The landlady asked Nadia was her room warm enough or should she fetch another blanket.
The landlady asked Nadia if her room was warm enough or whether she should fetch another blanket.
The landlady asked Nadia if her room is warm enough or if she would fetch another blanket.
The landlady asked Nadia that her room was warm enough or whether she shall fetch another blanket.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос передаётся через if/whether с прямым порядком слов и сдвигом is → was, а предложение с shall I в косвенной речи переходит в should she.

prompt: Omar arrived at the hotel in Bristol expecting a quiet room overlooking the courtyard. Instead, the clerk handed him a key for a noisy ground-floor room facing the car park. Omar politely asked the manager why (the office / already / to change) his booking without telling him. He wasn't even sure (a quiet room / still / to exist) on the top floor. Finally, he asked how soon (the porter / will / to carry) his bags upstairs.

blanks.cue: a quiet room / still / to exist
blanks.answer: if a quiet room still existed
accepted_answers: if a quiet room still existed
whether a quiet room still existed

explanation_ru: Три разных решения: в первом пропуске Past Perfect после why с прямым порядком слов; во втором общий встроенный вопрос с if/whether и Past Simple; в третьем сдвиг will → would.

prompt: Dark clouds rolled over the campsite in Wales as the lanterns flickered out. Nobody had expected the storm to arrive before dusk. Zuzana asked me (Youssef / to charge) the spare torch before we left home. He admitted he hadn't, so I wondered why (the wind / to blow) so hard through the zipped tent. Then Youssef asked me (the village shop / to sell) spare batteries.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске вопрос о более раннем действии требует if/whether и Past Perfect; во втором действие в момент речи передаётся Past Continuous; в третьем постоянный факт сдвигается в Past Simple.
